description: Bornes géodésiques IGN is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Christian Quest. Content Data extracted from geodesy sheets “in an open standard, easily reusable and usable by an automated processing system” (unfortunately only available as a PDF file on the geodesie.ign.fr website). The Base network has just under 3,000 terminals and landmarks grouped on just over a thousand sites. Coverage: Christian Quest. The portal shows the English title as "IGN Geodetic Bollards" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Christian Quest. Its keywords include gps, cartographie, geodesie. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2017-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
